data.posts_intro: Tips, updates and behind-the-scenes notes from our team.

children.text: Growww is a small studio of designers and developers who believe a great website should be
, not just nice to look at.
We've helped cafés, consultants and community groups launch sites they're proud of, and we stick around afterwards to help them grow.

$media.alt: A small team collaborating around a table

data.title: Welcome to Growww
data.excerpt: A quick hello, and a look at what we're building with Astro and EmDash.

$media.alt: A laptop and notebook on a desk

children.text: Welcome to our new site! It's built with Astro and managed with EmDash, so every word on the homepage can be edited from the admin panel, or by an AI assistant over MCP.
We'll be sharing tips on design, performance and running a small business online. Stay tuned.

data.title: Why fast websites win
data.excerpt: Speed isn't just a nice-to-have. It affects your search ranking, conversions and how visitors feel about your brand.

$media.alt: Analytics charts on a laptop screen

children.text: Every extra second a page takes to load costs you visitors. Shipping less JavaScript and serving pages from the edge keeps things snappy.
The fastest code is the code you never send to the browser.

data.title: Editing your site with AI
data.excerpt: How structured content fields make it easy for an AI assistant to update your website safely.

children.text: Because our homepage is broken into clearly named fields (hero, services, blog and about), an AI assistant connected over MCP can change exactly one thing, like the hero heading, without touching anything else.
"Change the homepage hero heading to something more playful."
